text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Let this flash of my blade be the hope 
that cleaves the dark of night—here I 
come!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, good movement. If you keep that up, 
it should make for a suitable workout to 
lose weight.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thank goodneeess~~! Alright, now I 
can escape this weight crisis...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you so much for keeping me 
company on my diet, Duramente-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I don't mind something like this.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Still... do you have experience in 
fencing? That fluid motion just now... I 
could hardly believe it was your first 
time holding a sword."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, actually, I practiced just a little 
bit before... because I admired Air 
Groove-senpai so much!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Air Groove-senpai's swordplay... It 
was seriously, super cool!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A female knight protecting her kingdom, 
you could say! She looked so cool, she 
could've stepped right out of a fantasy 
manga!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I agree. That dignified, beautiful 
figure... As an athlete, I can't help but 
feel a sense of admiration."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you too, Duramente-senpai!? ...Then 
would you like to aim for it together? Air 
Groove-senpai's swordplay, that is!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Us, like Big Sis Groove? ...Heh, it might 
actually be fun to give that a shot."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, Kiseki practiced fencing 
with Duramente, and successfully managed 
to slim down!"
